choices.why: No candidate is mustard velvet, so this warm cognac three-seater is the closest to the golden tone you asked for and grounds the colorful boho mix along the long right wall.
A classic natural rattan tub armchair, exactly the bohemian rattan seat requested, compact enough to face the sofa near the balcony door.
At 335 × 239 cm it is the only rug large enough to anchor both sofa and armchair, and its blue-and-rust pattern brings lots of color.
The multicolored folk-print cushions with red tassels deliver the cheerful, patterned look you asked for and pop against the cognac sofa and rattan chair.
These embossed cobalt ceramic pots echo the rug's blues and can be spread across the bookcase and corners, though they come empty and need plants added.

Listed at 140 cm wide and only 43 cm high, this wood-and-metal etagère is the one candidate low enough to sit under the back-wall window, though its photo looks taller, so check the height before buying.
The carved wooden drum table adds an artisanal, global boho touch and sits well on the rug in front of the sofa, though at 61 cm across it is on the small side.
Its turned wooden column and linen drum shade feel warm and collected, better suited to the boho mood than the chrome or white options.
The navy-and-cream geometric jacquard throw with fringe ties the rug's blues to the sofa and adds more pattern.

answer.why: Warm cognac, natural rattan and carved wood form a relaxed base, while the big blue-and-rust rug, folk-print cushions, cobalt pots and geometric throw layer in the color and pattern that make the space feel lived-in and cheerful. The main compromise is the sofa: none of the candidates is mustard velvet, so cognac leather stands in as the closest warm tone.
